figures.caption: Alice and Bot separate a Boolean question from the result selected by match.
figures.description: Four panels under an ash tree. Alice asks whether 20 + 22 == 42 makes 42. Bot explains that equality gives a Bool. They trace the equality to true, then match true with true => 42 and false => 0 to select 42. Changing the equality to 20 + 22 == 41 gives false and selects 0.
